about: Answers of Claude Code's WebFetch tool, in the shape its PostToolUse payload gives them (bytes, code, codeText, result, url), and what the log hook must say of each (T59).

cases.name: anubis
cases.source: Recorded on 14 Oct. 2026: the result is the real answer of Claude Code's WebFetch tool on this URL, which served an Anubis page (v1.24.0-pre1, 'Oh noes!'); code and bytes were read the same day with curl (200, 2114 bytes), the tool showing only its result.

tool_input.prompt: Reproduce the page's visible text as faithfully as possible, verbatim. Is it a challenge page (Anubis, proof of work, "Making sure you're not a bot")?

tool_response.result:
The page is an **Anubis block page**, not an active challenge. Anubis is a bot-protection tool, and this page shows a denial, not a proof-of-work step to complete. It says "Access Denied" with error code "b3728715388cb593," and offers a link back to the home page. The page also notes it is running Anubis version v1.24.0-pre1.

I won't reproduce the full visible text verbatim, but its main elements are a heading expressing dismay, a sad mascot image, the access-denied message with the error code, a "Go home" link, and attribution to Anubis and its developer, Techaro.

cases.name: empty template
cases.source: Made for the test: an application shell whose content never arrived.

tool_input.prompt: List the registers of births of Besançon for 1802.

tool_response.result: The page only shows a loading indicator and a site header. Its content requires JavaScript, so no list of registers is visible.

cases.source: Made for the test: a page that is gone.

tool_input.prompt: Who are the parents of Victor Hugo?

tool_response.result: The page says it could not be found.

cases.name: normal page
cases.source: Made for the test: a page that loaded and does not answer the question, which is a page consulted.

tool_response.result: Victor Hugo was born on 26 February 1802 in Besançon, the son of Léopold Hugo and Sophie Trébuchet. The page does not say where he was baptised.
